column4: An interrupted game-loading wait can no longer proceed while seed replay still owns and restores shared dungeon state.
Added real replay-thread tests for normal and interrupted loading waits, including preserved interruption status.
UIMSD navigation now uses SPD's existing grey buttons while preserving every existing action.
Demo and sample statistics use a compact amber DEMO DATA indicator with an information popup instead of a wide red banner.
Android checks now tap the compact data indicator and capture its popup alongside the rendered Home screen.
Recorded TEST77 checks, reproduced replay interruption and the corrected visual acceptance evidence.
I tightened replay isolation so loading waits for borrowed state to be restored. I also replaced the statistics screen's remaining red navigation and large demo banner with native grey controls.
